# mergegateway_project_controls (Resource)

Manages a Merge Gateway project's controls: the vendors, regions and zero data retention setting that override the organization's for this project. Leave an attribute out to inherit the organization's value. Destroying the resource removes every override, so the project inherits all of the organization's controls again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergegateway_project" "support_bot" {
  name = "Support bot"
}

# Keep the support bot on OpenAI and Anthropic in the US, preferring
# Anthropic, with zero data retention. Every other control is inherited
# from the organization.
resource "mergegateway_project_controls" "support_bot" {
  project_id = mergegateway_project.support_bot.id

  allowed_regions           = ["US"]
  allowed_vendors           = ["anthropic", "openai"]
  vendor_routing_preference = ["anthropic", "openai"]
  zero_data_retention       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project whose controls to manage. Changing it moves the overrides to the other project.

### Optional

- `allowed_regions` (List of String) The regions requests may be served from. A region is any active vendor's `country_code` or `geo_region`, such as `US`, `CA` or `NA`, and is case-sensitive; see the `mergegateway_vendors` data source. Regions are overridden together: setting either `allowed_regions` or `ignored_regions` overrides both, and the one left out is empty rather than the organization's.
- `allowed_vendors` (List of String) The vendors requests may be served by. Vendors are overridden together: setting any of `allowed_vendors`, `ignored_vendors` or `vendor_routing_preference` overrides all three, and those left out are empty rather than the organization's.
- `ignored_regions` (List of String) The regions requests are never served from. A region is any active vendor's `country_code` or `geo_region`, such as `US`, `CA` or `NA`, and is case-sensitive; see the `mergegateway_vendors` data source. Regions are overridden together: setting either `allowed_regions` or `ignored_regions` overrides both, and the one left out is empty rather than the organization's.
- `ignored_vendors` (List of String) The vendors requests are never served by. Vendors are overridden together: setting any of `allowed_vendors`, `ignored_vendors` or `vendor_routing_preference` overrides all three, and those left out are empty rather than the organization's.
- `vendor_routing_preference` (List of String) The vendors to prefer, most preferred first. When `allowed_vendors` is not empty, each must be in it. Vendors are overridden together: setting any of `allowed_vendors`, `ignored_vendors` or `vendor_routing_preference` overrides all three, and those left out are empty rather than the organization's.
- `zero_data_retention` (Boolean) Whether requests may only go to vendors that retain no data. Leave it out to inherit the organization's setting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project's ID, the same as `project_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a project's controls by the project's ID.
terraform import mergegateway_project_controls.support_bot 6f1c1f5e-8a8b-4c43-9a0e-3f0f6d0c8b11
```
